args.title: Fix password reset and other email links defaulting to localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, so password reset, rollup, and scheduled export emails link to localhost in environments where PUBLIC_URL isn't configured (apparently since last week's release). Fix this by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is always set to the correct production URL in deployment config, and/or by removing the localhost fallback here so misconfiguration fails loudly instead of silently emailing broken links. At minimum, update BASE_URL to use a correct, environment-appropriate default instead of localhost:3000.
